svg.title: Superficial muscles, anterior and posterior views
svg.desc: Whole-body superficial view. Left figure is anterior (patient right is viewer left); right figure is posterior (patient right is viewer right). Only superficial muscles are drawn; deep muscles are on regional plates. Pins are on the patient right limb.
